problem: Unless it rains, the match is played. It rained. Conclusion: the match was not played. Does the conclusion necessarily follow from the premises? Answer Yes or No.

formalization.problem_prop: ¬ (∀ (R M : Prop), (¬ R → M) → R → ¬ M)

macro "fv_auto" : tactic => `(tactic| first
  | (decide; done)
  | (norm_num; done)

  | (rfl; done)
  | (intros; tauto; done)

  | (intros; simp_all; nlinarith; done)
  | (intros; aesop; done)
  | (ring_nf; done)
  | (norm_num; ring_nf; done)

theorem final_wf : ¬ (∀ (R M : Prop), (¬ R → M) → R → ¬ M) := by sorry
theorem final_pos : ¬ (∀ (R M : Prop), (¬ R → M) → R → ¬ M) := by fv_auto
theorem final_neg : ¬ (¬ (∀ (R M : Prop), (¬ R → M) → R → ¬ M)) := by fv_auto
